assertions.name: m_p residual via exact 8·G Vol(𝓑₃) drops below 2 ppb
assertions.source: Replace stale Vol with 8·G; hardcoded 11-digit λ unchanged. Residual = literal truncation of λ_p; drops to ~10^-50 ppb with full-precision λ.

description: Tests whether replacing the stale Vol(𝓑₃) = 7.32772290 (SnapPy default-precision literature value, used in m_p_borromean_verification_50dps.py:68) with the exact 8·G = 7.32772475 closes the 250 ppb m_p residual. Hypothesis: the hardcoded λ_p_scale = 2.4599527869 was calibrated against CODATA m_p using the CORRECT 8·G value, so the stale Vol in the production formula introduces a compensating ~0.25 ppm error.

lambda_p_implied_from_CODATA.interpretation: If the hardcoded value matches the implied-via-8G λ to high precision, the hardcoded λ was originally fitted using the CORRECT Vol(𝓑₃) = 8·G, not the stale literature value. In that case the residual 250 ppb in production comes purely from the stale Vol(𝓑₃) in the formula.

lean_uniqueness_ref.note: T_w uniqueness at the abstract empty-constraint SDP level (PR #1537/#1542 parameterised module). Workplan: docs/workplans/2026-05-31-witness-lean-uniqueness-ref-wiring.md.
